subject.title: fix(providers): make Ollama and LM Studio onboarding reliable

question: After rebasing, should this PR’s automatic local-tool ownership transition be accepted for existing Ollama and LM Studio configurations, with the supplied upgrade-focused regressions as the compatibility contract?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes persisted onboarding behavior across local and hosted provider transitions; tests can establish mechanics, but maintainers must confirm that this remains the desired upgrade policy.

options.title: Accept the bounded ownership model
options.body: Review the rebase and merge if the current-base regressions continue to show that only onboarding-owned lean settings are added or removed.

options.title: Keep automatic lean settings unchanged
options.body: Reject the ownership-transition portion and retain the prior automatic setting behavior while landing only independent provider-validation repairs.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded ownership model
recommendation.body: Review the rebase and merge if the current-base regressions continue to show that only onboarding-owned lean settings are added or removed.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the cross-provider implementation and the live validation evidence, making them the best available person to clarify the intended onboarding ownership contract.
